headline: What an LLM actually does under the hood
narration: An LLM does not think or look up facts. At its core, it is a next-token prediction engine trained on trillions of words.

headline: Attention connects every word in context
narration: Self-attention lets the model weigh which earlier words matter most right now, across code, docs, or chat history.

headline: Why raw LLMs still hallucinate
narration: Because weights are frozen at training time, a raw LLM has no live memory and no access to your private database.
